text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To conquer the Kikuka-sho, I want to 
master an efficient running style this 
summer. Let's try everything we can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Ines Fujin decided to take on a 
new piecework job in her spare time. She 
also seemed to be picking up more 
part-time hours, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to learn how to run with better 
stamina efficiency remains strong, and her 
motivation for the training camp is as 
high as ever. Let's make this summer camp 
a fruitful one!
